token_budget_basis.node_purpose: Submit the already frozen eight-request material-scope classification as visible exact JSON without private chain-of-thought consumption.
token_budget_basis.input_scale: The immutable request contains 2781 prompt tokens, eight EvidenceRequests, nineteen product-intent dispositions and twelve required material-role surfaces.
required_outputs: one disposition for each of nineteen product intents
at least one bounded material atom for each of twelve required role surfaces
the unchanged plan digest and all eight request IDs
one visible exact JSON object accepted by the unchanged provider-neutral validator
token_budget_basis.schema_burden: The compact output uses request IDs, closed enums and integer index arrays. One atom may bind several metric or product axes collectively; the Harness expands identities and requirement groups locally.
token_budget_basis.materiality_and_quality_risk: Truncation or missing requests would silently omit research material, while enabling private reasoning again can consume the entire visible submission budget before any contract payload exists.
token_budget_basis.comparable_run_evidence: R1 used the same 2781-token prompt with max thinking and consumed 12000 of 12000 completion tokens as private reasoning with zero visible content. Existing DeepSeek non-thinking submission profiles have produced visible bounded contract payloads, but this material-scope surface has not yet been qualified.
token_budget_basis.reasoning_profile: Direct bounded classification and exact contract submission with thinking disabled; no financial research, retrieval, candidate review or narrative generation.
token_budget_basis.stop_and_truncation: The 8000-token visible-output ceiling provides more than two times the estimated compact contract surface. Any finish_reason other than stop, missing request, invalid enum, truncation or contract failure terminates without retry, local completion or microbatch fallback.

known_boundary: This successor changes only the replaceable DeepSeek submission profile. It does not alter the input, provider-neutral material-scope contract, research plan, S1 candidate set, Evidence authority, NumericFact authority or product state.
